learningObjectives: Understand missing-value handling and feature scaling
Explain why preprocessing improves machine learning workflows

activities.title: Data Cleaning Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the preprocessing steps in the correct order.

content.concept: Preprocessing transforms raw data into a cleaner and more consistent form suitable for machine learning.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Find the Data Problem
activities.instruction: Select the quality issue shown in each dataset example.

content.concept: Common data problems include missing values, duplicates, inconsistent formats, and outliers.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Scaling Lab
activities.instruction: Move the slider to compare raw and scaled feature values.

content.concept: Feature scaling puts numerical variables onto comparable ranges, which can benefit many ML algorithms.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Missing Value Strategy
activities.instruction: Choose an appropriate strategy for each missing-value scenario.

content.concept: Missing values can be handled by deletion, statistical imputation, or domain-specific replacement depending on the dataset.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Feature Engineering Builder
activities.instruction: Combine raw fields to construct useful machine learning features.

content.concept: Feature engineering creates informative variables from existing data to represent patterns more effectively.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
